definitions.explanation: The written text of a play, film, TV show, or other performance, containing dialogue, stage directions, and scene descriptions.

examples.japanese: {台本|だいほん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{読|よ}んで→読む：00426_yomu⟧⟦{練習|れんしゅう}する→練習する：22991_renshuusuru⟧。
examples.english: I practice by reading the script.

examples.japanese: ⟦{監督|かんとく}→監督：00185_kantoku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{台本|だいほん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{書|か}き{直|なお}した→書き直す：04597_kakinaosu⟧。
⟦まるで→まるで：03739_marude⟧{台本|だいほん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧⟦のように→のように：30291_noyouni⟧⟦{話|はなし}→話：01496_hanashi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{進|すす}んだ→進む：01225_susumu⟧。
examples.english: Things progressed as if there were a script.

notes:
Used for scripts in theater, TV, film, and radio. Can also be used figuratively to suggest something feels planned or staged.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {台本|だいほん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{書|か}く→書く：00477_kaku⟧ — to write a script
- {台本|だいほん}{通|どお}り — according to the script
- {台本|だいほん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{覚|おぼ}える→覚える：00739_oboeru⟧ — to memorize the script
- {台本|だいほん}⟦{読|よ}み→読み：00425_yomi⟧ — script reading (rehearsal)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{脚本|きゃくほん}→脚本：04459_kyakuhon⟧ — screenplay, script (more formal, emphasizes the written work)
- ⟦シナリオ→シナリオ：10940_shinario⟧ — scenario, screenplay (loanword, also used figuratively)
